constraints.meaning: Up to 100,000 characters. s can be empty.
constraints.impact: O(n²) is about 10¹⁰ steps: far too slow. You need O(n). For the empty string the loop never runs, so the answer must start at 0.

constraints.text: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces
constraints.meaning: Only ASCII characters, codes 0 to 127. A space is a character like any other.
constraints.impact: A counting array of size 128 replaces a hash map, which also makes a C version easy. Upper and lower case are different characters.

constraints.text: A substring is contiguous, with no duplicate characters (statement)
constraints.meaning: The characters sit next to each other, and no character appears twice.
constraints.impact: Contiguous + a rule every window must keep (no repeats) + the longest window → sliding window.

bruteForce.summary: try every start i, extend j to the right while the characters stay unique, and keep the longest length. O(n²) time, which is too slow for n = 10⁵.
